message0: auto-capture all tree structures at x %1 y %2 z %3 radius %4 height %5 max bonemeal attempts %6
tooltip: Server-side only. Loops over every tree sapling item (same set as 'list all tree sapling items'), and for each one: clears the capture area, plants it (as a 2x2 group for dark oak/pale oak, which vanilla only grows from a 2x2 sapling arrangement), grows it via bonemeal, saves it as a structure if it grew, then clears the area again before moving to the next sapling. Each sapling's structure is filed under its own source mod: generated/<modid>/structure/<sapling_modid>/<sapling_modid>_<sapling_item>.nbt (e.g. a Biomes O' Plenty mahogany sapling lands at .../structure/biomesoplenty/biomesoplenty_mahogany_sapling.nbt), so trees from different mods sort into their own folders automatically. 'height' is a scan ceiling, not the literal saved height: each capture is trimmed to the actual topmost non-air block found, so no empty air is saved above the tree. One block to capture every tree in the game at a single spot.
